race.comment: HELLOVA NATURE (1) consistent gelding with the three wins from his last four starts. Sent north when he finished over the top of them from a wide gate over 1350m at Doomben. Can stalk the speed here and take holding out with the 3kg claimer engaged. Value player. ATTRACTIVENESS (9) starting to hit her straps fourth-up and had excuses last time out in the heavy going when fifth in the small field over 1500m at this track. Will race much closer today and figure prominently on the better surface. CAPE BYRON (5) races best with his runs spaced and get the services of Nash Rawiller today. Never looked comfortable in the soft going when eighth over 1300m on June 27. Will roll forward and give plenty of cheek. KOIOS (6) hard fit now and must be considered with Zac Lloyd retaining the ride. KRASINA (12) got the Maiden win out of the way fourth-up and keep safe over the extra trip.
